wdl_quotient.state: (ply, deadEventPool, per-column next-relevant-event gaps, P0 minimal residual antichain, P1 minimal residual antichain)

output_sensitive_quotient.state: (ply, output-relevant deadEventPool, per-column output-relevant next-event gaps, Pi0 exact P0 residual provenance, P1 minimal residual antichain)
output_sensitive_quotient.Pi0: mapping/grouping from exact nonempty residual subset to the set of original live P0 geometric-line labels having that residual

transition_semantics: A neutral dead event decrements only the aggregate dead-event pool and advances ply.
A filler event before the next relevant event decrements that column's support gap and advances ply.
At a relevant P0 event, Pi0 origin labels follow exact residual subtraction; an empty result emits exactly those terminal line labels. P1 minimal requirements containing the P0 event are killed.
At a relevant P1 event, Pi0 groups containing the event are killed; P1's own residuals shrink and are antichain-normalized for value semantics.

After a relevant event, gaps and the aggregate dead-event pool are recomputed from the remaining output-relevant residual/event universe. Residuals never grow, so a column that becomes output-irrelevant cannot later regain relevance.
interpretation: The complete small-game control no longer requires colored-board state even for transitions: the structural quotient is generative from its own root.
The W/D/L quotient and the terminal-line-output quotient are different exact quotients of the same game.
The output-sensitive quotient is obtained by adding exact P0 line provenance and expanding event relevance accordingly, not by abandoning the residual/event ontology.
anti_leakage: No standard-7x6 perfect-play terminal-line subset, witness sequence, or solved-state table was used.
